The Hawks, led by 19th-year head coach [[Phil Martelli]], played their home games at [[Hagan Arena]] and were members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 24–10, 11–5 in A-10 play to finish in a tie for third place. They were champions of the [[2014 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] to earn the conference's automatic bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], where they lost in the second round to UConn. == Previous season == The Hawks were the preseason pick to win the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. However, they did not meet expectations and finished with an 8–8 record in the conference.{{Cite web |date=2013-09-11 |title=2013-14 Preview: Saint Joseph’s Hawks
